Method of Attack: Encrypting Linux devices, specifically targeting VMware ESXi virtual machines
Encrypting enterprise network systems with ransom notes
Scanning for and encrypting unpatched ESXi servers in a massive worldwide campaign
Discoverer: Will Thomas of the Equinix Threat Analysis Center (ETAC)
Impacted Systems: Healthcare and Public Healthcare (HPH) sector organizations
Indicators of Compromise: Detected by 23 out of 62 malware scanning engines on VirusTotal
Over 100 ESXi servers compromised worldwide in ESXiArgs campaign
